script_order: 0: firebase module bridge (window.firebase* globals) + firebase-config.js + auth.js

1 engine: game.js(G/Notify/Fade/loop) > lifecycle.js > scene.js > navigation.js > navigation_routes.js > diagnostics.js > scene-helpers.js > deprecation.js > input.js > audio.js > renderer.js > backgrounds.js

2 data (declarative, no logic): heroes, enemies, zones, map_layout, landmarks, perks, auras, items, classes, cultivation, alchemy_recipes, spirit_beasts, quests, achievements, journeys, encounters, zone_variants, bonds, narrative_echoes, world_events

3 systems (authoritative rules, mutate G.state): economy > zone_rewards > hints > progression > combat > duel > cultivation_sys > alchemy > world_state > narrative_echoes > world_events > influence_rules(data) > influence > landmarks > bond > save > farm > quest > achievements > journey > encounter > living_zones
4 ui (presentation-only factories): button > panel > progressBar > text > list > tabbar > modal > card > heroSurface > feedback

5 scenes (screens, enter/update/render/leave): title > characterCreate > ashram > map_helpers > travelMap > zoneExploration > combatScene > party > cultivationScene > alchemyScene > punarjanma > spiritBeast > forge > tournament > trials > bazaar > farm > fishing > settings > questLog > equipment > achievementsScene > debug > welcome > journeyScene > encounterScene > authScene
6 boot: src/main.js (registerScene table, boot guards, gInit)

key_edges.scenes->Navigation: all transitions via Navigation.go (legacy gScene wrapper compat)
key_edges.systems->G.state: sole mutation path; scenes/data/ui never mutate directly
key_edges.systems->SaveSystem: all persistence + migrate/normalize funnel through save.js
key_edges.combat buffs->Combat clones: bond/beast bonuses clone stats, never mutate base
key_edges.feedback->game loop: UI.Feedback queues drained globally in gLoop
key_edges.diagnostics->Settings: collectors gated by debug toggle, local only
key_edges.auth->optional: Firebase ready event -> Auth.init; offline boot never blocked

invariants: script order is a runtime contract
